subject: Request: Executive signoff for bespoke SLA & remedies for HaloPay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: HaloPay ask: reduced uptime target + discount — need exec signoff

Sean — quick summary from today's sync with HaloPay (Angela + Marco). They want two non-standard items to close: a) lower the uptime SLO floor from our standard 99.99% to 99.9% for a subset of low-priority endpoints (billing reconciliation) and b) a committed-capacity discount of 30% for a 12-month committed spend.

They've pushed back on our standard service credit cap (we cap at monthly pro rata up to 100% of monthly recurring charges) and asked instead for an explicit per-event credit formula with a higher cap for the first 3 months of onboarding. Legal supplied a redline (attached).

Ask: can I get executive signoff to accept the bespoke uptime floor and the temporary credit uplift for the onboarding window, conditional on (1) a 12-month minimum commitment, (2) gating the reduced SLO to a named subset of endpoints, and (3) added telemetry hooks (trace-level logs) that Vivek can commit to enable?

Attachment: [Attachment: HaloPay_SLA_Redline_20260812.pdf (pdf)]

Quick risks: lower public uptime target could set precedent; we should require internal approval to limit scope. If we get signoff today I'd like to lock terms and send for countersignature.

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Deal Desk <dealdesk@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HaloPay ask: reduced uptime target + discount — need exec signoff

Thanks Marissa — I appreciate the clear bullet points. Summarizing for execs: HaloPay (mid-market fintech) is asking for a scoped SLO reduction to 99.9% for non-customer-facing reconciliation endpoints only, a temporary increase in the per-event service credit during the first 90 days of onboarding, and a 30% committed-capacity discount for 12 months. Deal value (net) around $420k ARR; deal id DEAL-5892.

Vivek — can you confirm feasibility/effort to add the additional telemetry and whether the lower SLO materially increases our operational burden? Laura — confirm expected ramp and renewal probability with the 12-month commit.

If legal signs off on the redline and finance/Ethan are comfortable, I'll route to Marissa for final signature. Need exec approver on the higher-than-normal credit cap.

—Sean
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:35:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: HaloPay ask: reduced uptime target + discount — need exec signoff

Folks — I reviewed the redline and financials. High level: deal economics are OK if the 30% discount is strictly tied to a 12-month committed spend and we avoid making the reduced SLO global. Two items I want documented before I approve:

1) A defined rollback / remediation clause if we see >2 P1 incidents attributable to the reduced-endpoint group in the first 6 months (i.e., automatic return to standard SLO and pro-rated credits removed).
2) A clear runbook and on-call coverage guarantee from the infra team for the onboarding period; Vivek, can you estimate hours and whether this triggers overtime headcount?

Also: cap the elevated service credit to a fixed dollar ceiling per event for months 0–3 to limit exposure. If legal can craft those bullets in the contract I'm comfortable giving conditional approval.

—Ethan
VP Revenue Operations
From: Angela Ruiz <angela@halopay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco D'Souza <marco.dsouza@halopay.com>, HaloPay Legal <legal@halopay.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: HaloPay ask: reduced uptime target + discount — need exec signoff

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We can accept the scoped SLO reduction so long as the scope is explicit and there is a documented rollback if issues surface. We're OK with the 12-month commit and the 30% pricing once those guardrails are in place.

Per your request, attaching our counter-signed terms and a short note from our legal counsel listing the desired credit formula during onboarding. Happy to hop on a 30m call if you need to talk through implementation details.

Attachment: [Attachment: HaloPay_Counter_SLA_20260813.pdf (pdf)]

Best,
Angela Ruiz
Head of Platform, HaloPay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, HaloPay Legal <legal@halopay.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: Exec signoff granted for scoped SLO and onboarding credit (conditions)

All — Exec signoff granted with the following explicit conditions:

1) Scope: reduced uptime SLO to 99.9% applies only to the named reconciliation endpoints listed in Appendix A of the attached redline; all customer-facing APIs remain at 99.99%.
2) Onboarding credits: elevated per-event credit allowed for months 0–3, capped at $25,000 per event and $75,000 total for the onboarding window. After month 3 credits revert to standard formula.
3) Rollback: automatic revert to standard SLO and removal of discount if more than 2 P1 incidents attributable to the scoped endpoints occur within the first 6 months.
4) Telemetry & runbook: Vivek has committed to the additional trace-level hooks and a dedicated 24/7 on-call rotation for the first 30 days; runbook will be attached to the contract exhibit.
5) Commercial: 30% committed-capacity discount for 12 months, effective on execution.

Please route the final redline to DocuSign (link below) and loop Legal for the exhibit language. Once signed we will provision the scoped SLO in staging and enable the telemetry flags.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/US-Document/ABC1234
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-5892

Attachments: [Attachment: HaloPay_Signed_Term_Sheet.pdf (pdf)]

—Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
